oral_examination.oral_examination: 38 The mesial and low-lying impaction is hidden, and the mucosa covers the distal maxillofacial surface. There is no abnormal color, no redness, swelling, or congestion. Nothing special.

source_handle: 38 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local povidone-iodine disinfection, alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride, and infiltration anesthesia with bistriol around the wisdom teeth. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the crown part of the tooth is divided by grinding with a mobile phone, the mesial obstruction is released, the pieces are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are taken out. The tooth extraction wound was routinely scratched and sutured (1 stitch) to stop bleeding.
